item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"The program makes one parent call and one direct child call, then asserts `prog.history == 1` and both `prog.cot.history` and `prog.cot.predict.history` equal 2."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"It proves shared ancestry history by checking object identity with `id(prog.history[0]) == id(prog.cot.history[0])`, not just value equality."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"After `disable_history=True`, it performs another LM call and asserts all three history lengths remain unchanged at 1, 2, and 2."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The example is runnable and correctly uses `DummyLM` with `JSONAdapter`, defines a parent `dspy.Module` delegating to a `ChainOfThought`, and calls both parent and child."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
